name: Re:Curse
source:
"... Our universe is coming to an end... 

Come, let us toast to the little time we have left..."


To Allison, life is just an endless cycle of exhaustion with no escape route– wake up, study, work, fulfill family duties, sleep, rinse and repeat.

But sometimes she can't help but wonder...

Is that really all there is to life?

Soon, Allison stumbles upon a group of people who may be just as lonely as she is, and little by little, their encounter returns colour to her world...

[From [url=https://elseth.itch.io/recurse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“……我们的宇宙即将终结…… 

来吧，让我们为所剩不多的时间干杯……”


对艾莉森来说，生活只是一个无休止的疲惫循环，没有出路——起床、学习、工作、履行家庭义务、睡觉、漱口，然后重复。

但有时她又忍不住想……

这真的是生活的全部吗？

很快，艾莉森偶然发现了一群可能和她一样孤独的人，他们的相遇逐渐为她的世界增添了色彩……

[来自[url=https://elseth.itch.io/recurse]itch.io[/url]]
